messages:
frank: Kicking off a short 'permission declutter' run to shrink admin entitlements and validate KMS bindings before audit intake. Aim: reduce blast radius, keep CI/cron safe. Will do owner attest -> small canary -> phased removals.

sasha: Threshold suggestions? I vote 90d humans / 180d service accounts, with explicit tags to preserve monthly/quarterly jobs.

irma: Agreed. Also treat any cross-project or external-principal KMS grant as high-risk and require manual review regardless of age.

sec-bot: preflight: scanned 1,945 principals, flagged 103 admin-level bindings, 31 KMS keys with non-owner principals. Snapshot: gs://compliance/snapshots/2491234567/before.json (immutable). Report: https://internal/reports/perm-declutter-2491234567

frank: Canary plan: pick 5 low-risk bindings across infra/analytics/etl, demote admin->viewer for 48h, include one KMS-touching job. Monitor jobs, API error rates, and KMS decrypt errors.

kms-bot: KMS safety: automation will run impersonated decrypt probes before mutating key IAM. Example probe (will be in the playbook):
```bash
# impersonate and attempt decrypt
gcloud kms decrypt --location=global --keyring=kr --key=mykey --ciphertext-file=/tmp/ct --project=proj --impersonate-service-account=${PRINCIPAL} || echo "decrypt-failed"
```
If probe fails -> mark `needs-owner-attest` and skip auto-removal.

sasha: We need rollback tools: `infra/tools/rbac-restore --snapshot gs://compliance/snapshots/2491234567/batch-<n>.json` and a tag `perm-declutter:pause=true` kill-switch to immediately halt automation. Also wire canary alerts to #eng-oncall.

irma: Owner ping draft: "Hi @owner, security will review entitlements on `<resource>`. `<principal>` holds `<role>` and has not been active since `<last_seen>`. Please attest or add tag `perm-preserve=true` within 7 days or non-owner entitlements will be demoted. See snapshot: gs://compliance/snapshots/2491234567/."

sec-bot: will export CSV with columns: principal, role, resource, last_seen, kms_crossproj_flag, kms_probe_result, recommended_action, reapply_command, owner_contact. All CSVs and snapshots are immutable and retained per compliance policy.

auditor: For the external audit we need per-principal attestation records linked to the snapshot and a brief justification. Ensure attestations are recorded in the ticket and stored in the compliance bucket. Retention = 7y.

sasha: Action items:
- sasha: create canary batches + owner ping list (ETA: Thu)
- irma: prepare KMS probe harness + skip logic for failed probes (ETA: Wed)
- frank: PR for automation + rbac-restore playbooks + kill-switch webhook (ETA: Fri)
- sec-bot: produce CSV + upload immutable snapshots (ETA: Thu)

frank: Canary scheduled Monday 09:00 PT. If canary triggers >2 failed scheduled jobs or any KMS decrypt failures for production keys, automation pauses and #eng-oncall is pinged. We'll keep this thread for live runbook updates. :lock:
